fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest create a weak fundamental backdrop ahead of earnings in 6 days.

sentiment.summary: Modest congressional buying interest from two representatives (76-114 days old) lacks conviction; neutral market fear/greed and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation or contradiction.

risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (241.28) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 6 days creates compounded downside risk for INTU.

debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 6 days combined with VIX crisis levels (241.28), inverted yield curve, price below both 50/200 EMAs, negative money flow, and weak fundamental backdrop create compounded downside risk that outweighs technical signals.
